highlights: Voxel Remesh 3-4x faster, always in the background so the app never freezes
High-DPI Windows laptops (150-200% scaling): the window opens inside the screen
The right tray opens in every look on 1280 px screens; QuickMenu gets square thumbnails
New update channel: Preferences > Updates picks Stable or Preview (betas)
Pattern brushes work on micro levels: Dragon Scales, Skin Pores and the rest keep their pattern, and Wrinkle carves
Windows portable zip starts on a fresh PC (Visual C++ runtime included), and a failed start now says why
Cmd+, (Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux) opens Preferences
Move with Pressure > Size on a pen grabs the whole brush again (Move and Kelvinlet grab brushes)
Micro levels keep up on slower computers: on a slow-core laptop, a big 300 px dab went from 97 to 60 ms
